quick.title: Quick text
quick.label: Type what you spent
quick.placeholder: e.g. yaar aaj canteen par 350 kharch kiye
quick.help: Write it the way you would say it out loud — the amount, the category and the date are read from your sentence.
quick.sureCategory: Category taken from the words you used
quick.fallbackCategory: No word matched, so this went to the closest category — change it if it is wrong
quick.noAmount: No amount in that sentence — try something like “canteen 350”.
quick.tooShort: Type a little more, with an amount in it.
surv.title: Survival mode
surv.seeItOnDashboard: See the plan on the dashboard
surv.perDay: a day for the {days} days left in this month
surv.dailyLine: That is {amount} a day — the strict limit.
surv.short: Your committed bills are {amount} more than you have. Cancel or delay one before the month ends.
surv.nothingLeft: Nothing is left to spend until the next income arrives.
surv.slower: You have been spending {current} a day, above the limit. Bring it down to {target}.
surv.holding: You are at {current} a day, under the {target} limit. Keep it there.
surv.committedLine: {count} recurring bills still land before the month ends.
surv.negative: Your balance is below zero — the next income is what fixes this.
surv.offTight: Only {days} days left, and the bills still due are more than your balance.
surv.offHint: {days} days left this month and {amount} in the balance. Turn this on to get a strict daily limit.
surv.onToast: Survival mode is on — your daily limit is set.
